C1_native_failure.denominator: 71 closed captures; 33 complete, 38 incomplete; 261 original files, 558440887 raw bytes
C1_native_failure.evidence: earlier_UI3_failed_overnight sealed final closure, native replay disabled
C1_native_failure.limit: Smaller 50-capture live snapshot is not this final population

C2_software_cohort_results.denominator: Every retained TC-01 pair row; unavailable delivered predictions reported separately
C2_software_cohort_results.limit: No pooling, detrending, residual selection or electrical output inference

C3_native_state_and_UI.denominator: 409 observed TC-01 status rows, not wall-time duration
C3_native_state_and_UI.evidence: final-sampled-status.csv and indexed first_observations raw byte locators
C3_native_state_and_UI.limit: Transition times bracketed by adjacent observations; first observed lock is not a cold-start acquisition time

C4_physical_association.denominator: 3579 retained originals: 3543 with all three TX-stage logs, 36 with original match and incomplete TX-stage logs
C4_physical_association.limit: Not an RF completion probability; logger loss and missing emitted opportunities are not identified

C5_delays_and_losses.evidence: pair.correction_availability_latency_ns and retained_original_gap_s; sampled counter increments
C5_delays_and_losses.limit: Hardware timestamp intervals and processing delays, not USB arrival timing or measured RF-loss rate

C6_deployed_method.evidence: git-show frozen installed include/ptob_tc_oscillator.h and src/main_copy.c, protocol/config hashes
C6_deployed_method.limit: Current dirty shared firmware is not the installed method; no deployed PI or tunable oscillator

C7_hardware_extension.evidence: Original dimensional PI/actuator derivation and primary manufacturer literature
C7_hardware_extension.limit: Proposed architecture and validation; no tunable-hardware measurement or guaranteed precision

C8_operating_tier.evidence: Native software state contract plus proposed capability and independent-validation gates
C8_operating_tier.limit: SOFTWARE_PLL is optional algorithmic status, not public authority or qualified total-error bound

delivered_causality_order_checks.invariant: 0 < output_delivery_before_tick <= local_tick <= available_tick; every plotted delivered score checked

metric.coverage: sampled native status counts, never continuous duration or RF delivery ratio
metric.denominator: all retained parsed pair rows in the named capture/epoch; unavailable rows separate
metric.error: reference nominal TX ns minus earlier delivered map at physical original RX
metric.percentile: nearest rank ceil(p*n) of absolute errors, matching native analyzer
metric.rms: sqrt(sum(error_ns^2)/n); signed mean retained; no detrending/outlier removal
metric.sign: positive means delivered software coordinate lags reference event coordinate
